newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand eases controls on bank, finance rates.
newsitem.headline: Thailand eases controls on bank, finance rates.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand said it has eased its control on fixed deposit rates of commercial banks and finance companies in an attempt to spur deposits.
In a circular obtained by Reuters on Saturday, the central bank said it set the limit of commercial banks' fixed deposit with a maturity of three months and higher at 14 percent.
The BOT previously capped all commercial banks' deposit rates at 12 percent.
It said finance companies' fixed deposit rates with the same maturity would be controlled at 17 percent compared with previous limit of 14 percent, he said.
The central bank late last month had decided to control banks' and finance firms' deposit rates in a move to ease the finance sector's burdens in competition for funds.
The bank said banks and finance companies suffered from slow domestic deposits amid a slowdown of foreign fund inflows following the flotation of the baht earlier this month.
